# Playroll

> > Playroll is a global HR, payroll, and compliance platform enabling companies to hire, manage, and pay employees and contractors across 180+ countries with expert support.

Playroll provides end-to-end workforce management solutions including Employer of Record (EOR) services, global payroll processing, contractor management, visa sponsorship, and HR compliance tools. The platform leverages AI-powered guidance (Orbit) to simplify international hiring and compliance across multiple jurisdictions.

## Key Topics

- Employer of Record (EOR)
- Global Payroll Services
- Contractor Management
- Global Hiring & Employment
- HR Compliance
- Visa & Work Permit Sponsorship
- Talent Mobility
- GDPR & SOC 2 Compliance
- HRIS Integration
- Payroll Analytics & Reporting
- International Expansion
- Employee Benefits
- Orbit AI Assistant
- Multi-Country Payroll
- Workforce Management
